name: Pick up the Male Lead
source:
You’ve just arrived in a new town, carrying a bag full of secrets. No one here knows your past—or why you left your old life so suddenly. The university you’ve just transferred into is famous… and full of people far more complex than they first appear.

Between classes, internships, local cafés, and student parties, you’ll cross paths with individuals who shake up your routine. Each in their own way will help you rebuild your world. But be careful… some smiles hide scars, regrets... or truths you may not be ready to face.
